prompts.text: A premium minimalist cosmetics poster with the headline "PURE GLOW" in elegant black serif letters on a cream background.
A large airport departure board displaying "FLIGHT 88 -- TOKYO -- GATE 12 -- ON TIME" in amber monospace letters.
一张高档商场的中庭广告牌，写着大号汉字“璀璨新生”，下方是英文“NEW SEASON”。
一幅中国风水墨海报，竖排书法“山高水长”，右下角有红色印章。
A science museum exhibit placard reading "ELEMENT 79 — Au — Gold — 196.97 u" next to a gold nugget.
一张地铁换乘图海报，标题“换乘指南”，站名包含“人民广场”“科技园”“博物馆”，均用黑体汉字。
A vintage neon hotel sign reading "HOTEL PACIFIC" with one flickering letter, photographed at night.
A rural crossroads with two wooden road signs: "Maple Farm 2 mi" pointing left and "Lake View 5 mi" pointing right.
A 1960s-style jazz festival poster: bold typography "BLUE NIGHTS JAZZ FEST", saxophone silhouette, limited palette.
一张环保主题海报，中央是地球插画，上方大字“守护地球”，下方小字“绿色生活 从我做起”。
A craft beer bottle label reading "OLD MILL BREWING — AMBER ALE — 5.4% ALC" with vintage wheat illustrations.
A premium tea tin with a label that says "EARL GREY" and below it smaller text "BLACK TEA WITH BERGAMOT".
A single dew-covered red rose on a dark slate surface, studio macro photography.
A vintage brass compass resting on an old nautical map.
A wooden kitchen island with a bowl of lemons, a cutting board with basil, olive oil bottle and linen towels.
A lighthouse on a cliff with waves crashing below and seagulls circling above, shot from a passing boat.
Exactly four hot air balloons of different colors drifting over a patchwork farmland at dawn.
A violinist performing alone in a grand empty concert hall, single warm spotlight.
An impressionist oil painting of a Parisian cafe terrace in the rain.
A lone cabin window glowing warm in a snowy pine forest under the aurora borealis.
A grand library interior with spiral staircases, brass lamps, thousands of leather-bound books, a librarian on a rolling ladder, dust motes in shafts of afternoon light.
An elaborate chocolate shop window display: tiered stands of truffles, a flowing chocolate fountain, handwritten price cards, marble counter, warm reflections at dusk.
A birthday cake with white frosting and cursive writing on top that says "Happy 30th Emma!".
一块中式园林的石碑，上面刻着绿色汉字“听雨轩”。
A periodic-table style poster for a coffee shop: cells reading "Espresso 25", "Latte 30", "Mocha 35", prices in dollars.
A bright pharmacy cross sign glowing green at a street corner in evening rain, reflections on wet asphalt.
A bold movie poster for a space documentary titled "DEEP SKY" with a nebula background and small credits text at the bottom.
A jar of honey with a kraft-paper label reading "WILDFLOWER HONEY — NET 16 OZ — LOCAL HARVEST".
一张课程表贴在教室墙上，标题“五年级三班 课程表”，包含科目“语文 数学 英语 科学”。
A wooden directional signpost at a hiking trailhead with four arrows: "Summit 4.2 km", "Waterfall 1.1 km", "Campground 2.7 km", "Ranger Station 0.5 km".
